text:
tina: deploy-bot blocked `redwood/worker:release-2026.02` push to eu-west-1. Failure: attestation verification failed (cosign verify) — KMS key not found for signature ARN. Anyone on-call for signing infra?

deploy-bot: Automated: publish blocked for tag `release-2026.02` (build 6821). Reason: attestation_signature_kms_not_found. Regions affected: eu-west-1. Suggestion: retag to known-good digest or re-sign with available key.

carlos: I see the cosign attestation was created with KMS ARN `arn:aws:kms:us-central-1:111:alias/redwood-signing-key` but verifier in eu-west-1 is trying to call `DescribeKey` in eu-west-1 where that alias doesn't exist. Looks like key rotation/replication timing problem.

priya: Did we rotate the platform signing key earlier today? I pushed the KMS rotation scheduled change at 09:10 UTC. That might be the window.

dave: Confirmed: rotation happened 09:12 UTC. Replication to eu keys isn't instantaneous for aliases; verify ops doc. Cosign records the key ARN from the signing operation, so verification attempts in other regions will fail if the alias isn't available there.

tina: We are inside the 10:00-11:00 UTC change window. Options: 1) retag previous digest to release-2026.02 in eu-west-1 (fast, keeps provenance), 2) re-run cosign signing in eu-west-1 against current manifest (requires a key present in eu-west-1), 3) delay promotion until key replication completes (~30m). Preference?

carlos: +1 retag previous digest. Keep the release flowing and minimize impact. We'll add a ticket to improve key replication/lookup fallback.

priya: I'll open the release-note PR to call out the digest pin and note the KMS rotation impact. Also adding rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Proposed automated action: create tag `release-2026.02-retag-1822223333`, inject existing attestation (sha256:bbb222...), promote to `release-2026.02`. Requires manual approval from release lead.

tina: Approved. @carlos please run the retag command and share status here.

carlos: Running now. Command: ```bash
# retag to previous digest in eu-west-1
./tools/gcr-retag --repo redwood/worker --from-digest sha256:bbb222ffffffff --to-tag release-2026.02 --region eu-west-1
```

publishbot: Retag job started. Verifying attestation injection.

publishbot: Retag complete. `release-2026.02` in eu-west-1 now points to sha256:bbb222ffffffff. Attestation attached and verified locally.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled in 8m. Routing configured to pinned digest for canary hosts. Monitor metrics for 15m.

priya: PR #921 opened: "Pin release-2026.02 in eu-west-1 to previous digest + release notes (KMS rotation)". Assigning to @tina. Included rollback runbook and change-window note.

tina: Reviewed and merged. I've also added an ops note: avoid KMS alias rotation inside active publish windows; create a pre-rotation checklist.

carlos: I'll file INF-4410 to add a fallback in verifier: if KMS DescribeKey fails in target region, try calling the KMS ARN region or surface clearer error to release owner.

priya: Also adding a small automation: wait 30m after key rotation before allowing cross-region verification jobs to run, unless override flag provided. Patch request in infra PR #233.

dave: Runbook update done: added KMS-rotation checklist and a note to pause publishing for 20m post-rotation.

tina: Summary: retagged to previous digest in eu-west-1, merged release-note pin, created INF-4410 for verifier fallback, added runbook entry and infra PR to introduce a post-rotation delay. Monitoring canary for 20m. Thanks. :thumbsup:

priya: Small follow-up: we'll coordinate with security on a safer rotation schedule and publish it in the monthly maintenance calendar.

carlos: Noted. I'll also add a CI test that validates attestation verification across target regions in a pre-publish step.

tina: Closing thread — keeping watch on canary metrics. If anything spikes we'll roll back to the pinned digest and open an incident.
